title: fix(app-shell): a report's or dataset's Name keeps every underscore typed (objectui#12746)
body:
Fixes #12746
Clause-②: no (designer only; no export, prop or type changes)

## What changes

The report and dataset designers' **Name** box (create mode) committed every keystroke through the strict `toFieldName`. That rule trims a trailing `_`, so the underscore was gone before the next key arrived: `qavrf_rev` typed key by key read `qavrfrev`, and a report or dataset in a namespaced package could not get its `qavrf_` prefix by typing. Clearing the box also wrote `field` back into it.

Both boxes now commit through `toFieldNameLoose`, imported from where it already lives beside `toFieldName` (`previews/object-fields-io.ts`), which is what the object designer's Name does. Nothing else moves, so the strict form stays exactly where the object designer keeps its own:

- the Label → Name derivation still uses strict `toFieldName`, so a Label typed with a trailing space or punctuation never leaves a trailing `_` in the Name;
- `nameFollowsLabel` still compares the stored Name with the strict form of the Label. A Name the author extends with `_` therefore stops following the Label, and a later Label edit leaves it alone;
- the spec's identifier rule still judges the saved name (the client check for report, the runtime for both). The loose form only ever yields a lowercase identifier that starts with a letter, or an empty box.

An existing item's name is untouched: the Name box renders only in create mode, as before.

Files: `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` and `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx` (the Name commit and its import in each, plus a comment), one test beside each, the objectui#12680 host-level test (its report and dataset cases typed `qavrfrevenue` with a comment saying those Name fields could not carry a separator; they now type `qavrf_hand_typed` like the object case), and `.changeset/12746-report-dataset-name-keeps-underscore.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

## Browser readings (Chromium, real keystrokes)

Backend: objectstack `66d456d01` `examples/app-crm`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` on a private port. Console: this branch's worktree on Vite, proxied to it. A writable package created with `POST /api/v1/packages` `{"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.vrf",…,"namespace":"qavrf"}}` → 201. Pages: `/apps/crm_app/metadata/{report,dataset,object}/new?package=com.qa.vrf`. Name typed `qavrf_rev` key by key, then Label typed `Revenue Board` and tabbed out of. Control: a fresh form, Label only, typed `Revenue Board ` then `Q`.

| designer | Name after typing, before (`3e2c763`) | after (`a5cbab9`) | Name after the Label edit, after | Label only: mid-edit / final, before and after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| report | `qavrfrev` | `qavrf_rev` | `qavrf_rev` | `revenue_board` / `revenue_board_q` (unchanged) |
| dataset | `qavrfrev` | `qavrf_rev` | `qavrf_rev` | `revenue_board` / `revenue_board_q` (unchanged) |
| object (control) | `qavrf_rev` | `qavrf_rev` | `qavrf_rev` | `revenue_board` / `revenue_board_q` (unchanged) |

After the fix, a dataset named by typing `qavrf_rev` (Label `Revenue`, base object `opportunity`) saved through the designer's Save button: `PUT /api/v1/meta/dataset/qavrf_rev?mode=draft&package=com.qa.vrf` → 200, `Saved dataset 'qavrf_rev' (env-wide, package=com.qa.vrf, state=draft)`.

## Tests

New, one beside each inspector, each rendering the inspector with a host double that merges every patch back into the draft (real user-event keystrokes):

- `ReportDefaultInspector.nameKeepsUnderscore-12746.test.tsx`
- `DatasetDefaultInspector.nameKeepsUnderscore-12746.test.tsx`

Each file pins four things: (1) `qavrf_rev` typed key by key stays `qavrf_rev` in the box and in the draft; (2) a cleared Name stays empty and can be typed again; (3) the Label → Name derivation keeps the strict form (`Revenue -- Board ` derives `revenue_board`, then `Q` derives `revenue_board_q`); (4) a `_` typed onto a derived Name (`qavrf` → `qavrf_`) makes the Name the author's, so a later Label edit (`Qavrf Board`) leaves `qavrf_`.

Final run at `a5cbab9`, after the closure build: `pnpm exec vitest run` over the report, dataset and object inspector suites (every file whose name starts with `ReportDefaultInspector`, `DatasetDefaultInspector` or `ObjectDefaultInspector`) plus `ResourceEditPage.nameSurvivesLabel-12680.test.tsx` → `Test Files 14 passed (14)`, `Tests 125 passed (125)`.

## Red on unchanged main, and one ablation per pin

Each leg ran the three touched test files (24 tests). Every mutation was proven on disk (anchor count and blob hash), and every restore was proven by blob hash equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| leg | mutation | result | what went red |
|---|---|---|---|
| R0: unchanged main (pins 1, 2 and 4) | both inspectors replaced by their `3e2c763` blobs (`toFieldNameLoose` count 0 in each) | `10 failed, 14 passed` | report and dataset pin 1 (`qavrfrev` for `qavrf_rev`), pin 2 (`field` for an empty box), pin 4 (`qavrf` for `qavrf_`); objectui#12680 report and dataset typed-Name cases (`qavrfhandtyped` for `qavrf_hand_typed`) |
| A3 (pin 3) | the Label derivation's `toFieldName(v)` replaced by `toFieldNameLoose(v)` in both inspectors | `2 failed, 22 passed` | pin 3 in both files: the Name stuck at `revenue_` (the loose derivation leaves `revenue_`, which no longer equals the strict form of the Label, so the Name stops following) |
| A4 (pin 4) | `nameFollowsLabel` compares the strict form of the Name (`toFieldName(nameValue)`) in both inspectors | `2 failed, 22 passed` | pin 4 in both files: the Label edit replaced the author's `qavrf_` with `qavrf_board` |

Pin 3 is green on unchanged main by construction (main applies the strict form everywhere); A3 is the leg that shows it can fail. All tests here import the inspectors through relative source paths, so no `dist/` build sits between a mutation and its run.

## Local gates (all at `a5cbab9`)

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' run build` → exit 0 (28 packages built).
- the vitest run above → exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the test project's include glob covers the new `*.test.tsx` files) → exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the five changed source and test files → exit 0, 0 errors; 7 warnings, all on lines this diff does not touch (`react-refresh/only-export-components`, `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any`).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` → exit 0, "5 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` → exit 0, `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.

Everything else is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not changed here:** the report and dataset Label → Name derivation writes `field` when the Label holds no Latin letters or is cleared. In Chromium, on this branch (the derivation lines are byte-identical to `3e2c763`): Label `收入` derives Name `field` in both designers, and clearing the Label leaves Name `field`. The object designer derives an empty Name in both cases, which asks the author for one. The cause is the strict `toFieldName` fallback (`'field'` for an empty result) in the derivation, which this card keeps as it is. Reported to the seat, not filed from here.
